text.title: Growth Referral Programs Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the referral-programme spec: an NPS gate measured on active users within 90 days and at or above 30, a named instrumented trigger event with its reach, a qualifying event (paid order above a minimum or an activation milestone) stated on the landing page and in every email, a double-sided incentive whose cost per qualified referee sits at or below paid CAC and a stated share of first-order margin or LTV, a fraud guard with self-referral matching on four signals, a reward hold and the (referrer_id, referee_id, qualifying_event) idempotency tuple, a K-factor computed as invites per referrer times conversion per invite on at least 500 invites and 50 referrers with cycle time and presented as a 1/(1-K) multiplier below 1, server-side attribution from a per-user code, a lifecycle of announcement, one reminder to zero-referral users and a confirmation to both sides, and disclosure with published terms. Validator at scripts/validate-growth-referral-programs.py enforces it, including the reward arithmetic against CAC and margin, the K product and the multiplier.

required.field: `metric` nps or willingness_to_recommend, `score` (at least 30 when the metric is nps), `sample_size`, `population` active_users, `measured_on`, `age_days` at most 90 (r-nps-gate-30-before-launch)
`name` of the instrumented value event the prompt fires on (never signup or a first screen), `reach_share` of users who reach it, `instrumented` true (r-trigger-event-at-value-moment)
`kind` first_paid_order (with `minimum_order_value`) or activation_milestone, `name` of the event, `stated_on_landing_page` and `stated_in_every_email` true (r-reward-on-qualifying-event-not-signup)

`referrer_reward` and `referee_reward` each with `kind`, `amount` above 0 and `currency`; `reward_cost_per_qualified_referee` equal to their sum, at or below `blended_paid_cac` and at or below `max_reward_share_of_basis` x `margin_basis_value` for the stated `margin_basis` (r-double-sided-incentive-within-unit-economics)

`referee_must_be_new_account`, `one_referral_per_email`, `one_referral_per_payment_instrument` true; `self_referral_signals` covering payment_instrument, device_fingerprint, ip and normalised_email; `email_normalisation` covering plus_addressing and dot_variants; `reward_hold_days` and `reward_hold_covers` refund_window or chargeback_window; `idempotency_key` exactly referrer_id, referee_id, qualifying_event (r-fraud-guard-self-referral-and-idempotent-rewards)

`invites` at least 500, `active_referrers` at least 50, `referee_signups`, `invites_per_referrer` = invites / active_referrers, `conversion_per_invite` = referee_signups / invites, `k` = their product, `cycle_time_days`, `presented_as` cac_multiplier whenever k is below 1 with `cac_multiplier` = 1 / (1 - k), `netted_of_reward_cost` true (r-k-factor-computed-on-500-plus-invites)

`per_user_code`, `landing_page_accepts_param`, `email_accepts_param` true; `capture_methods` from url_parameter, first_party_cookie, code_at_signup; `persisted_server_side_at` referee_account_creation; `utm_only` false (r-referral-attribution-server-side)

`announcement.send_on` equal to the trigger event; `reminder` with `after_days`, `audience` zero_referrals, `max_sends` 1; `confirmation` on qualifying_event to referrer and referee; `promises_reward_before_qualifying_event` false (r-lifecycle-sequence-trigger-reminder-confirmation)

`reward_disclosed_on_shared_content` true, `terms_url`, `terms_cover` with qualifying_event, reward_timing, exclusions and fraud_reversal, `earnings_claims[]` each with `claim`, `period` and `verified` true (r-incentive-disclosure-and-published-terms)

forbidden.pattern: `nps_gate.score` below 30 on the nps metric, or `age_days` above 90, or a population other than active users — launching on anecdote instead of a measured gate (r-nps-gate-30-before-launch)
`trigger_event.name` that is signup, account creation or a first or welcome screen — prompt-before-value-moment

`qualifying_event.name` that is signup or account creation, a first_paid_order kind without `minimum_order_value`, or the condition not stated on the landing page and in every email — reward-paid-on-signup
a reward with `amount` 0 on either side, or `reward_cost_per_qualified_referee` above `blended_paid_cac` or above the stated share of margin or LTV — reward-above-paid-cac
`self_referral_signals` missing any of the four signals, `reward_hold_days` 0, or an `idempotency_key` that is not the (referrer_id, referee_id, qualifying_event) tuple — self-referral-unchecked
`k_factor.invites` below 500 or `active_referrers` below 50, `k` not equal to invites_per_referrer x conversion_per_invite, or K below 1 presented as viral_growth — k-factor-from-a-handful-of-invites
`capture_methods` containing a utm parameter, `utm_only` true, or attribution persisted anywhere other than at referee account creation — attribution-by-utm-only

a reminder whose audience is not zero-referral users or that sends more than once, a confirmation that does not reach both sides, or any message promising a reward before the qualifying event (r-lifecycle-sequence-trigger-reminder-confirmation)
shared content without reward disclosure, `terms_cover` missing one of the four topics, or an earnings claim with `verified` false or no period (r-incentive-disclosure-and-published-terms)

example.code: { "programme_name": "give 20 get 20", "nps_gate": {"metric": "nps", "score": 42, "sample_size": 640, "population": "active_users", "measured_on": "2026-08-14", "age_days": 30}, "trigger_event": {"name": "first_successful_export", "reach_share": 0.57, "instrumented": true}, "qualifying_event": {"kind": "first_paid_order", "name": "first_paid_order", "minimum_order_value": 50, "stated_on_landing_page": true, "stated_in_every_email": true}, "incentive": { "referrer_reward": {"kind": "account_credit", "amount": 20, "currency": "USD"}, "referee_reward": {"kind": "discount", "amount": 20, "currency": "USD"}, "reward_cost_per_qualified_referee": 40, "blended_paid_cac": 95, "margin_basis": "first_order_gross_margin", "margin_basis_value": 126, "max_reward_share_of_basis": 0.35 }, "fraud_guard": { "referee_must_be_new_account": true, "one_referral_per_email": true, "one_referral_per_payment_instrument": true, "self_referral_signals": ["payment_instrument", "device_fingerprint", "ip", "normalised_email"], "email_normalisation": ["plus_addressing", "dot_variants"], "reward_hold_days": 30, "reward_hold_covers": "refund_window", "idempotency_key": ["referrer_id", "referee_id", "qualifying_event"] }, "k_factor": { "invites": 4200, "active_referrers": 850, "referee_signups": 630, "invites_per_referrer": 4.94, "conversion_per_invite": 0.15, "k": 0.741, "cycle_time_days": 9, "presented_as": "cac_multiplier", "cac_multiplier": 3.86, "netted_of_reward_cost": true }, "attribution": { "per_user_code": true, "landing_page_accepts_param": true, "email_accepts_param": true, "capture_methods": ["url_parameter", "first_party_cookie", "code_at_signup"], "persisted_server_side_at": "referee_account_creation", "utm_only": false }, "lifecycle": { "announcement": {"send_on": "first_successful_export"}, "reminder": {"after_days": 14, "audience": "zero_referrals", "max_sends": 1}, "confirmation": {"send_on": "qualifying_event", "recipients": ["referrer", "referee"]}, "promises_reward_before_qualifying_event": false }, "disclosure": { "reward_disclosed_on_shared_content": true, "terms_url": "https://example.com/referral-terms", "terms_cover": ["qualifying_event", "reward_timing", "exclusions", "fraud_reversal"], "earnings_claims": [{"claim": "this month's top referrer has earned 300 USD", "period": "2026-08", "verified": true}] } }
example.note: NPS 42 on 640 active users 30 days ago passes the gate; reward 20 + 20 = 40 is below paid CAC 95 and below 0.35 x 126 = 44.10; K = 4200 / 850 x 630 / 4200 = 4.94 x 0.15 = 0.741, presented as a 1 / (1 - 0.741) = 3.86 multiplier; the announcement fires on the trigger event.

example.code: { "programme_name": "refer a friend", "nps_gate": {"metric": "nps", "score": 22, "sample_size": 40, "population": "active_users", "measured_on": "2025-06-01", "age_days": 400}, "trigger_event": {"name": "signup", "reach_share": 1, "instrumented": true}, "qualifying_event": {"kind": "activation_milestone", "name": "account_created", "stated_on_landing_page": false, "stated_in_every_email": false}, "incentive": { "referrer_reward": {"kind": "account_credit", "amount": 20, "currency": "USD"}, "referee_reward": {"kind": "discount", "amount": 0, "currency": "USD"}, "reward_cost_per_qualified_referee": 20, "blended_paid_cac": 15, "margin_basis": "first_order_gross_margin", "margin_basis_value": 18, "max_reward_share_of_basis": 0.5 }, "fraud_guard": { "referee_must_be_new_account": false, "one_referral_per_email": true, "one_referral_per_payment_instrument": false, "self_referral_signals": ["ip"], "email_normalisation": [], "reward_hold_days": 0, "reward_hold_covers": "none", "idempotency_key": ["referrer_id"] }, "k_factor": { "invites": 30, "active_referrers": 6, "referee_signups": 4, "invites_per_referrer": 5, "conversion_per_invite": 0.133, "k": 0.9, "cycle_time_days": 7, "presented_as": "viral_growth", "cac_multiplier": 1, "netted_of_reward_cost": false }, "attribution": { "per_user_code": false, "landing_page_accepts_param": true, "email_accepts_param": false, "capture_methods": ["utm_source"], "persisted_server_side_at": "analytics_session", "utm_only": true }, "lifecycle": { "announcement": {"send_on": "signup"}, "reminder": {"after_days": 3, "audience": "all_users", "max_sends": 4}, "confirmation": {"send_on": "signup", "recipients": ["referrer"]}, "promises_reward_before_qualifying_event": true }, "disclosure": { "reward_disclosed_on_shared_content": false, "terms_url": "", "terms_cover": ["reward_timing"], "earnings_claims": [{"claim": "top referrer earned 300 USD", "period": "", "verified": false}] } }
example.note: NPS 22 measured 400 days ago on 40 users; the prompt fires on signup; the reward releases on account creation and the condition is stated nowhere; the referee gets nothing and 20 per referee exceeds paid CAC 15 and 0.5 x 18; self-referral matching on ip only, no hold, an idempotency key of referrer_id alone; K from 30 invites and 6 referrers presented as viral growth; attribution by utm_source in an analytics session; a reminder to all users four times and a confirmation only to the referrer before any qualifying event; no disclosure, no terms, an unverified earnings claim.

list.item: `nps_gate` is a measurement on active users at most 90 days old with a sample size, and the score is at least 30 when the metric is nps.
`trigger_event.name` is a value event with its reach recorded, and `lifecycle.announcement.send_on` is the same event.
`qualifying_event` is a paid order above `minimum_order_value` or an activation milestone, stated on the landing page and in every email; nothing pays on signup.
`reward_cost_per_qualified_referee` equals the two reward amounts added together, and is at or below `blended_paid_cac` and at or below `max_reward_share_of_basis` x `margin_basis_value`.
`fraud_guard` matches on all four self-referral signals, holds rewards through the refund or chargeback window, and fulfils on the (referrer_id, referee_id, qualifying_event) tuple.

`k_factor` rests on at least 500 invites and 50 referrers; `invites_per_referrer` = invites / active_referrers, `conversion_per_invite` = referee_signups / invites, `k` = their product, and a K below 1 is presented as `cac_multiplier` = 1 / (1 - k).
Attribution is a per-user code persisted server-side at referee account creation; `utm_only` is false.
One reminder, to zero-referral users only; confirmation to both sides on the qualifying event; terms cover all four topics and every earnings claim is verified for its period.

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the cross-field rules (reward sum and its ceilings against CAC and margin, K arithmetic per templates/k_factor.py, the 1/(1-K) multiplier, announcement on the trigger event).
